Package dev.opencollab.paletter.data

Class DataVersion

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.data.DataVersion
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<DataVersion>
public final class DataVersion extends Object implements Comparable<DataVersion>
A version of bundled vanilla Bedrock data.

One data version usually serves several protocol versions (hotfixes rarely change palettes), so lookups by protocol version resolve to the newest data version whose protocol is not newer than the requested one.

A version is identified by its name and protocol: equals, hashCode and compareTo use those two (ordered by protocol, then name), not whether it is a preview or which codec decoded it.

Since:
1.0.0

      public @Nullable Integer codecProtocol()
      The protocol of the codec that decoded the captures this data was built from, where that was not the version's own: a preview captured before the protocol library had a codec for it. Such data may lack what the newer protocol added to the packets it was read from.
      Returns:
      the protocol of the codec, or null if the data was decoded with the codec of its own protocol
